positive_terms: Explanation of whether and how biodiversity and ecosystems-related policy supports traceability of products, components and raw materials with significant actual or potential impacts on biodiversity and ecosystems along value chain
政策对产品与原料可追溯性的支持
说明政策是否以及如何支持对生物多样性和生态系统有重大实际或潜在影响的产品、部件和原材料的可追溯性。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
